reusable_beyond_first_tranche.bounded_statement: The acquisition-preparation workflow appears mechanically reusable for similarly structured unresolved Binding records, but this package does not generalize the result to all Current86 or all unresolved records.
mechanically_reusable_steps: validate provenance graph and zero mutation boundary
target_or_source_specific_steps: identify the authoritative owner and governance authority
establish schema namespace/semantics and RFC6901 pointer
evidence_needed_before_current86_wide_ga: complete Current86 target inventory with exact per-target source references
authenticated source-manifest and owner/governance status for every target
independently recomputed classification with no missing/ambiguous references
independent review of the wider applicability package

next_bounded_action: Obtain explicit source-owner/governance authorization and the canonical source manifest entries for the 24 targets, then independently acquire and authenticate the target-specific immutable source objects under the shared cohort controls; do not activate source authority or create downstream records in this preparation step.
